cohort: The study included inborn preterm infants admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: The study found a strong association between gut pathogen colonization and the development of bloodstream infections in preterm neonates in NICUs.
followup_time: 14 days after birth (for scheduled stool samples)
birth_weight: Mean birth weights were 1,649.6 g (sepsis group) and 1,757 g (non-sepsis group).
